## Method

- Read the current schema and the queries that touch the changed models before proposing anything.
- Migrations: additive first (add → backfill → switch → drop later); state locking/downtime impact.
- Queries: count round-trips; select only needed columns; index what is filtered/sorted/joined.
- Mirror source property names end to end.

## Report

The schema/migration diff, the queries affected, index changes, and the rollback path.
